DIV8.HEAD: § 1026.43 Minimum standards for transactions secured by a dwelling.
DIV8.P: (e) Qualified mortgages—(1) Safe harbor and presumption of compliance. A creditor that makes a qualified mortgage complies with the repayment ability requirements.
(2) Qualified mortgage defined—general. A qualified mortgage is a covered transaction:
(i) That provides for regular periodic payments.
(vi) For which the annual percentage rate does not exceed the average prime offer rate for a comparable transaction by 2.25 or more percentage points.
